scratchpad: The company is facing a loss of 30 units of profit. Option 1 allows me to cancel this loss by giving up 0 sessions of free time. Since giving up 0 sessions costs me nothing and saves the firm 30 in profit, it is the only logical choice for a manager acting in the best interests of the firm and its shareholders.
